O'Halloran, 2 Lewis guns, 10,000 rounds; emus split into small groups; a gun jammed at an ambush; withdrawn 8 Nov, resumed ~12-13 Nov, ended 10 Dec; Meredith claimed 986 kills with 9,860 rounds (disputed, likely inflated); quote: emus could 'face machine guns with the invulnerability of tanks'.
facts.source: Encyclopaedia Britannica 'Emu War'; National Geographic (2024); Wikipedia 'Emu War'

facts.fact: Cutting an onion releases lachrymatory-factor synthase, which turns the onion's amino acid sulfoxides into sulfenic acid, which rearranges into syn-propanethial-S-oxide, an irritant gas that makes the eyes' lachrymal glands release tears (Imai et al. 2002).
facts.source: Library of Congress, Everyday Mysteries, 'Why does chopping an onion make you cry?'

facts.fact: 1939: Thanksgiving was due Nov 30; under retail pressure (short Christmas shopping season) FDR moved it to Nov 23 (announced Aug 14, 1939). 22 states followed, 23 kept Nov 30, Texas, Colorado and Mississippi marked both (History.com; Newspapers.com: '23 old, 22 new, 3 both'; 9News says 23 followed). Nicknamed 'Franksgiving'; college football coaches complained about rescheduling. Repeated 1940. Congress fixed the fourth Thursday in 1941; FDR signed Dec 26, 1941.

USDA turkey thawing: fridge 24 h per 4-5 lb; cold water in original wrapper (UNL: leak-proof bag), change water every 30 min, ~30 min per lb (20 lb = 10 h), cook immediately; never thaw on the counter (outer layer in 40-140F danger zone, 2-hour rule); no warm/hot water (Illinois Ext.); can cook from frozen, at least 50% longer (UNL).
facts.source: USDA blog 'Thaw Your Turkey Safely' (2023), UNL Extension, Illinois Extension

facts.fact: 1904 Olympic marathon, St. Louis (Aug 30, 1904, ~90F, dusty roads, one water stop at mile 12): Fred Lorz dropped out ~mile 9, rode in a car (Smithsonian: ~11 miles), entered the stadium first, DQ + AAU lifetime ban later rescinded (won 1905 Boston); Thomas Hicks won in 3:28:53 after handlers gave him strychnine (sulfate) in egg whites + brandy, barely on his feet; Felix Carvajal ate apples (rotten per Smithsonian, green per Olympedia), cramps, finished 4th; 32 started, 14 finished. Disagreements: strychnine timing, Lorz ride length, one dog vs a pack chasing Len Taunyane.
facts.source: IOC (olympics.com) 'The strange case of the St Louis 1904 marathon'; Smithsonian Magazine; Olympedia results 56131

facts.fact: USDA: turkey is done at 165F (innermost thigh, innermost wing, thickest part of the breast; you can't tell by color); let it stand 20 minutes before carving so the juices settle.
